title: Easy Toddler Blueberry Muffins
summary: Makes: about 12 mini muffins or 6 regular muffins Ingredients * 1 ripe banana, mashed * 1 egg * ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt * 2 tablespoons melted butter or neutral oil * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract * ¾ cup all-purpose flour…
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted butter or neutral oil
½ cup blueberries, fresh or frozen
steps: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a mini muffin pan or use liners.
Mash the banana well. Stir in the egg, yogurt, melted butter, and vanilla.
Add flour and baking soda. Stir just until combined.
Gently fold in the blueberries. For younger toddlers, you can smush or chop larger blueberries.
Bake ~15 minutes for mini muffins or ~20-30 minutes for regular muffins, until a toothpick comes out clean.
caption: Easy Toddler Blueberry Muffins 🍌🫐 Makes: about 12 mini muffins or 6 regular muffins Ingredients * 1 ripe banana, mashed * 1 egg * ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt  * 2 tablespoons melted butter or neutral oil * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  * ¾ cup all-purpose flour * ½ teaspoon baking soda * ½ cup blueberries, fresh or frozen Directions 1. Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a mini muffin pan or use liners. 2. Mash the banana well. Stir in the egg, yogurt, melted butter, and vanilla. 3. Add flour and baking soda. Stir just until combined. 4. Gently fold in the blueberries. For younger toddlers, you can smush or chop larger blueberries. 5. Fill muffin cups. 6. Bake ~15 minutes for mini muffins or ~20-30 minutes for regular muffins, until a toothpick comes out clean. 7. Cool before serving.  #easyrecipe #toddlermeals #momrecipes❤️ #toddlerbreakfast #toddlersnack
